abstract: # ZR-0: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision **ZR-0** is a pre-trained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation model designed for general-purpose robotic manipulation. ZR-0 System Overview: Joint Vision–Language Reasoning and Continuous Action Control --- ## Table of Contents - [What is ZR-0?](#what-is-zr-0) - [Key Features](#key-features) - [Target Audience](#target-audience) - [Quick Start](#quick-start) - [Environment Setup](#environment-setup) - [Model Checkpoints](#model-checkpoints) - [Model Inference](#model-inference) - [Evaluation](#evaluation) - [Fine-Tuning ZR-0 on Custom Datasets](#fine-tuning-zr-0-on-custom-datasets) - [Current & Future Work](#current--future-work) - [Contributors](#contributors) - [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) --- ## What is ZR-0? ZR-0 is a 2.6B parameter end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that leverages dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) supervision to learn cross-embodiment representations for robotic manipulation. **Architecture.** ZR-0 adopts a dual-stream architecture: a pre-trained VLM (Qwen3-VL-2B) serves as System 2 for structured reasoning, while a Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based action expert serves as System 1 for continuous action generation via flow matching. The two are coupled through cross-attention, with an attention mask that allows ECoT to be entirely skipped at inference, achieving ~90ms per action chunk on a single A6000 GPU. **Training Data.** ZR-0 is pre-trained on [ProcCorpus-60M](https://procvlm.github.io/), comprising 60M+ frames (~1,000 hours) from 400K+ trajectories across diverse embodiments (Franka, xArm, GR-1, ALOHA, ARX5, UR5, etc.), with 96.8% of frames annotated with dense ECoT reasoning traces. Example of Embodied Chain-of-Thought Reasoning **Training Objectives.** ZR-0 is jointly optimized with two objectives: next-token prediction for ECoT reasoning, and flow-matching for continuous action chunk generation. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：构建 2.6B 参数的双流 VLA 基础模型：以 Qwen3-VL-2B 作 System 2 进行结构化 ECoT 推理，以 DiT 动作专家作 System 1 通过 flow matching 生成连续动作块，两者用 cross-attention 耦合，并通过注意力掩码使推理时可完全跳过 ECoT，用下一 token 预测 + flow matching 两目标联合优化。


# 一、动机

> 现有 VLA 模型多依赖动作标签做端到端模仿学习，缺乏显式的中间推理监督，导致跨本体泛化能力与可解释性不足；同时推理开销与实时控制难以兼顾。ZR-0 试图用密集的具身思维链（ECoT）监督来弥补这一空白。


# 二、方法

> 构建 2.6B 参数的双流 VLA 基础模型：以 Qwen3-VL-2B 作 System 2 进行结构化 ECoT 推理，以 DiT 动作专家作 System 1 通过 flow matching 生成连续动作块，两者用 cross-attention 耦合，并通过注意力掩码使推理时可完全跳过 ECoT，用下一 token 预测 + flow matching 两目标联合优化。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在 ProcCorpus-60M 上预训练，该语料含 60M+ 帧（约 1000 小时）、400K+ 条轨迹、覆盖 Franka/xArm/GR-1/ALOHA/ARX5/UR5 等多种本体，其中 96.8% 的帧带密集 ECoT 推理标注；单张 A6000 GPU 上每个动作块推理约 90ms，具备实时控制能力。


# 四、对我的启发

> 目前公开信息以 GitHub/项目页为主，缺少具体基准任务成功率等量化对比，预训练数据与模型的真实增益仍需验证；其『推理可跳过』的注意力掩码设计对实时机器人部署很有参考价值，密集 ECoT 标注管线也为跨本体数据构建提供思路。
